      "observations": [
        "All 2630 owned diff lines and every functional hunk across 53 changed paths were read. Cargo.lock contributes five bounded dependency names. The one R100 cancellable_request move has identical blobs and receives no new semantic-body credit.",
        "DoOperation moves from the EWS client to protocol_shared and takes Client and Err as trait parameters. Each changed EWS operation imports the shared trait and moves ServerT to its implementation. The read-status override still emits partial successes before an aggregated failure; it does not acquire the default all-or-error completion path.",
        "Shared failure handling borrows an inner moz_http::Error through TryInto. EWS, Graph and ProtocolError adapters return a borrowed HTTP error only for their HTTP variant. The outgoing listener retains transport-security status and security-info handling; other errors use their nsresult conversion. No Clone bound is added to the shared operation contract.",
        "SafeListenerWrapper and listener aliases become public for cross-crate callers, while UnsafeListener stays private under the existing private_bounds exception. The RefPtr constructor ownership contract is reused. The temporary EWS adapter and SafeUrlListener unsafe accessor are removed; this does not remove every unsafe FFI call.",
        "Graph connectivity moves into its own operation module. The bridge now passes a clone of the URI it returns into that operation, which supplies that URI to both success and failure completion. The existing me GET and AboutMe selection remain; returning the URI is still separate from async completion.",
        "Folder wrappers now accept String and Option<String> instead of EWS FolderId values; EWS callers extract each id. Required IDs, parent IDs and names still fail with NS_ERROR_FAILURE when absent. CopyMoveSuccess conversion moves into the EWS move module, outside the shared simple listener.",
        "The shared MessageHeaders trait, mail_parser implementation and Mailbox code match the earlier bytes after explicitly removing EWS-only sections and widening trait visibility. The historical EWS Message newtype and convert_mailbox helper keep EWS-specific types outside the shared module. The current EWS headers.rs path is absent; no later replacement is inferred.",
        "The message-header wrappers retain all method bytes except two inspected visibility declarations. StaleMsgDbHeader and UpdatedMsgDbHeader are not renamed or semantically redefined in this patch. The older naming and short alias-documentation lessons are linked rather than restated as new policy.",
        "The shared fetch listener keeps the i32::MAX length guard but returns ProtocolError::Size instead of EWS Processing. The EWS caller now uses Ok(...?) to convert that error. The accepted helper retains the guard and copies data into its stream. Size still reaches the ordinary NS_ERROR_UNEXPECTED conversion fallback.",
        "The outgoing safety comment changes the null-pointer condition to no security error, matching the actual match expression. SafeUri gains Display by calling GetSpec and formatting the output string; it does not inspect GetSpec status. These scoped source facts do not establish all error or lifetime behavior under fresh execution.",
        "No test path or assertion changes in the owned patch. Current generic errors, outgoing failure handling and fetch conversion were read; four exact current Graph/listener proof objects are reused unchanged from 4387. Current later interface names and client shutdown support are separate phases.",
        "The accepted MessageHeaders trait remains shared and has a later is_flagged member. That extra member and the later removal of the EWS adapter are not attributed to this migration.",
        "Full retained primary Bug 2010053 current 0–2, activity and footer were read. Its request to share wrappers and its closure establish intent and phase identity. Actual ownership, lifetime, callback and error contracts come from the inspected source, not the Bug title.",
        "Own D279064 full timeline and all 13 actual inline bodies were read, including both older diff 1185314 response-cloning bodies. The author reports replacing Clone with borrowed references and lifetimes. Final Response has no Clone derive and is byte-identical across this commit; the intermediate proposal is not an owned response-file change or a blanket Clone rule.",
        "The review first tolerates a temporary shared ews dependency, then the author chooses wrapper types rather than relying on future removal. The final manifest and EWS adapter match that choice. Requests to keep UnsafeListener private and use the common URL-listener wrapper are adopted in the actual final source.",
        "The author offers a broader ProtocolError abstraction as a possible alternative, and the reviewer raises future sync-token differences. Those are bounded discussion, not mandatory abstraction policy or proof that Graph and EWS sync tokens are interchangeable.",
        "The earlier full D277114 context is reused by exact original ID e11030bb0879fb62b16100355ead7d19c470fa4c486a3b4a034b1129fba251d2 and original reader scope. No raw body is copied and no second complete read or independent confirmation is claimed.",
